card.line: Enaim was a city on the road to Timnah, where Tamar sat by the entrance and met Judah in a story that shaped his family.

moments.title: Tamar waits at the entrance
moments.text: Tamar took off her widow's clothes, covered her face with a veil, and sat at the entrance to Enaim. She saw that Shelah had grown up but had not been given to her as a husband.

moments.title: Hirah searches for the woman
moments.text: Hirah took a young goat to get back Judah's items and asked the men at Enaim about the woman by the road. They said no shrine prostitute had been there.
